name: Cowboys and Gayliens
source:
Cowboys and Gayliens is a yeehawing story about cowboys in love!

Follow Mouthwash the alien (he/them) as he struggles to put together the perfect birthday party for his rooting tooting cowboy boyfriend Noah (they/him). A story about being gay, letting yourself be loved, and being really, really soppy.

[from [url=https://dandelionmanager.itch.io/cowboys-and-gayliens-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《牛仔与盖利人》是一个关于牛仔相爱的令人惊叹的故事！

跟随漱口外星人（他/他们），努力为他的牛仔男友诺亚（他们/他）举办完美的生日派对。一个关于同性恋、让自己被爱以及变得非常非常悲伤的故事。

[来自[url=https://dandelionmanager.itch.io/cowboys-and-gayliens-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
